learning.design: Keep provider continuation payloads in server-side storage and hand only an opaque signed capability to the internal provider orchestrator. Bind consumption to tenant, provider run, worker, current provider state, evidence, verification, safety decision and the consumed recovery action grant.
learning.integration_rule: The browser/admin recovery endpoint must remain sanitised. Only an internal provider orchestrator may consume the capability and pass the retained continuation into the normal provider adapter runner.
learning.next_step: Port this proven contract into canonical WFM source as a new derived staging candidate, add the internal provider runner, then prove real checkpoint continuation and reconciliation before any hosted or production claim.

claim_boundary: Security/reference proof only. The reference module is not imported by the sealed 0.6.76 runtime and does not repair the currently deployed provider-recovery handoff gap.
